title.narrative: Skill Up! - Unlocking success: Empowerment of vulnerable Youth

description.narrative: Direct target group:The action is targeting 300 less advantaged unemployed and underemployed youth aged 18 – 30 years with 50% of them being female. Additional emphasis will be laid on inclusion i.e. persons with disability (PWDs) and other categories that are on the fringes of society. The project aims to equip participants with skills in market relevant vocational, agricutural and waste management trades following an integrated training approach which combines technical apprenticeships in the work place with life skills and entrepreneurship training laced with digital literacy. Upon completion of the technical training, apprentices in the beginer category will be assessed and issued with the officially recognized certificate of DIT. Participants will be enrolled into a post training support scheme for mentorship, top up training and business start-up or business enhancing support. Six to 09 months after the completion of the training each of the 02 cohorts will be followed once and the results of this follow up will constitute a tracer study to measure the impact of the action/intervention. The Skill Up! approach will guide the implementation modality of this project. Indirect target group (members of households, community):Up to 50 training providers are targeted by the project, these will receive a ToT during which ToT training plans will be developed and existing ones improved upon. The youth who participate in the project are members of a household averaging 4.4 members (based on the latest population census average household size in 2024) each in addition to the extended family of relatives. In one way or another, these youths will contribute to the wellbeing of their households. Many of the targeted female youth are young mothers – the trainings given such as the nutrition and sexual & reproductive health rights modules are highly relevant for such youth. The number of indirect beneficiaries for this project is estimated to be more than 1,320 persons.

Overall objective (Impact):The economic stability and decent income generation of vulnerable young people have improved through gainful / profitable employment or self-employment, resulting in increased food and nutrition security.Project objective (Outcome):Young vulnerable people use the acquired (labour) market relevant competencies and the provided access to necessary resources & labour market linkages to secure (self-) employment opportunities.

This project aims at contributing to the realization of decent incomes among the targeted youth who are in two categories: (1) those without any prior skills in the trade they aspire to grow a career and (2) those aiming to up their skills in addition to previously acquired competences and in which they may already be practitioners in the respective industry or prospecting to practice. The path to the realization of this objective is by employing non-formal TVET delivered within the private sector (MSMEs) in the localities of the targeted youth following short term modularized apprenticeships blended with mentorships, counselling, life and business skills training mainstreamed with Digital literacy for the targeted NEETs following the Skill Up! Program approach.
